input_messages.content: Hi, I just placed an order with two watches, and I need to make some changes.
I don’t remember my email, but my name is Noah Ito and my zip code is 98187.
I don’t have the order ID handy. Can you just check my most recent order? That’s the one with the two watches.
No, that’s not the one. The order with the two watches is different. Can you check the order before that? That should be the one I want to update.
First, I want to change the shipping address to my New York address. It’s the same one I used in another order. Can you update it to that?
Yes, please go ahead and update it to that address. Also, I want to change the silicone strap watch to a metal strap. If there are color options for the metal, I’d like white.
Yes, that’s all correct. Use the same Mastercard for any price difference. Now, I also need to change something in my other order—the one with the air purifier and speaker.
For that order, I want to change the air purifier to the large size, with night mode, but I still want the HEPA filter. The speaker stays the same.
Yes, that’s exactly what I want. Use the same Mastercard for any extra charges.
Yes, please go ahead and make those changes.
That’s all I needed. Thanks for your help. ###STOP###
